message:
I see. When the format is not RAW, `is_big_endian` and `is_unsigned_samples` in the `DecoderSession` struct are not initialized. But in `write_callback`, they are only used when the format is RAW (the fallback case). So if format is RAW, they are set. If format is not RAW, they are not used. So this shouldn't be the issue.

Let me look at the `replaygain.dither_context` which is noted as "gets initialized later once we know the sample resolution". Let me look at where it's used and initialized.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/flac && grep -n "dither_context" src/flac/decode.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
